tei:div.tei:p: "!# thugs sgrub yang 'dus them med gras/

: thod sgrub rin chen 'bar ba yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so: kho bo ratna gling pa'i khyad chos so// ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rgya gar skad du: ratna ka pā la siddhi u pa dhe sha nā ma: bod skad du: rin po che thod sgrub kyi man ngag ces bya ba: dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas ka pā la la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rin chen gter mdzod rgyud las phyung: yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub pa bstan: 'di la sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum: dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la: sgrub pa'i dam rdzas gsag pa ni: lha klu mi yi gnas gsum na: yid bzhin nor bu gsum yod de: lha la nor bu ke ke ru: klu la yid bzhin nor bu ste: mi la mtshan ldan ka pā la: 'di gsum nor bu rin po che: de yang thod pa mtshan ldan pa: kha dog dkar ser smug po la: snum la 'od ldan brjid che ba: mi sa nor sa kun 'jam pa: rang sa tshugs shing dgra sa 'jam: mthil na gshong bu bzhi ldan zhing: mdun na nor bu lta bu'i gshong: dpag bsam shing la 'bru chags pa: shing lo bag tsam mdun phyogs 'gugs: 'jam la shas mnyam tshangs bug can: dum bu gcig nas lnga yi bar: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i thod pa ste: khyad par bkra shis dum gsum mo: rgyas pa thod bshad spyi dang mthun: de lta bu yi thod pa las: dngos grub ma lus thams cad 'byung: de la zla ba yar gyi dus: gza' skar tshes grangs bzang ba la: bkra shis phyug po'i zhing sa la: maṇḍal byas te tshom bu bkod: thod pa phyi brdar legs byas te: mi sar bdag gi mi pho mo'i: rigs rgyud dar zhing 'phel rgyas su: gyur cig ces pa'i 'dod gsol bri: nor sar 'bru nor rin po che: dpag med rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol bri: gu gul bgegs bskrad dri bzang byug: 'khor lo yar bstan thod par gzhug: de yang nang du sgrub rdzas ni: ratna lnga dang sman sna lnga: dar sna dri lnga 'bru sna lnga: dkar gsum mngar gsum dar zab dang:

phyug po bsod nams ldan pa yi: lag nas 'bru sna zas sna dang: phyugs kyi spu la sogs pa blugs: spaus dang sman gyi thum po dang: shing thog gser g.yu khrab byang dang: sha mar thud la sogs pa gzhug: de dag sngon 'gro'i rim pa 'o: ༈ de nas dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni: phyi nang mchod pa gtor tshogs bsham: las byang gzhung bsrang mtshams kyang gcad: thod pa dar dmar dag gis dril: gzhan yang dar sna lnga yis dril: yid bzhin nor bur bsam byas la: maṇḍal dbus su mañdzi'i stegs: bzhag ste dar gyi gur yang phub: las byang gzhung bsrang mchod pa'i dus: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: chos skyong nor lha gter bdag la: ratna ka pā la 'bul na: bdag la mchog dang thun mong dang: khyad par mi nor zas gsum gyi: dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: zhes pa'i 'dod gsol rim yang gtang: de nas phyug po'i lug pho yi: nam tshong spu la snying bal/gzungs thag bya: de nyid bzung la sgrub sngags bzla: shin tu gces pa'i dmigs pa ni: bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i: thugs ka'i 'od zer kha dog lnga: thod pa'i nang du 'phros pa yis: thod pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i: yid bzhin nor bur gyur par bsam: thod pa las ni 'od zer lnga: khyad par dmar po shas che ba'i: rtse la lcags kyus mtshan pa ni: 'jig rten phyogs bcur 'phros pa las: bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyal srid bdun: dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba: ma rmos lo thog gter gyi bum: nor lha mi nor zas gsum dang: mdor na yid la gang 'dod pa: 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus drangs: thod par thim pa yang yang bsam: thod pa yid bzhin rin po che: nor bu kun 'byung dngos bsam la: dus bzhir 'dod gsol mchod tshogs 'bul: yid bzhin nor bu'i sngags 'di bzla: oṃ ratna ma hā ka pā la sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: ratna puṇye siddhi siddhi hūm̐: dha naṃḥme dhi siddhi siddhi hūm̐: nā nā kha dhe siddhi siddhi hūm̐:

dha la saṃ bho siddhi siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥdza: ma yengs ngang nas gsal dag bzla: zhag ni rab bdun 'bring lnga dang: tha ma gsum du thun bcad bsgrub: 1$0000250de tshe rtags kyi rim pa ni: dngos sam nyams dang rmi lam du: thod pa dag la me 'bar dang: mar khus khengs dang gser g.yus khengs: rin po che dang gter rnyed pa: nor sna 'bul dang 'bru sna 'bul: dos kyis khyim gang phyugs khyu 'dus: mi ro bshas dang lo tog rgyas: de sogs rtags rnams mang byung tshe: 1$0000300las sbyor sngags 'di zhag gcig bzla: na ma ka pā la sha ra ya dzaḥhūm̐ hūm̐: muṃ ha ri swā hā: de ltar sgrub pa thon pa dang: chos skyong bskang zhing gtor ma gtang: thod nang rdzas las dngos grub blang: mi la mi sbyin rang gis bza': 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab: 'bru sna sogs kyis kha gsos la: dar gyis dril te gwa 'u 'am: yang na khug ma'i nang du gzhug: mi la mi bstan shin tu gsang: khyad par mdze pho yugs sa dang: dam nyams sogs kyis mthong mi rung: 'di zhus bla ma gtsug tu khur: zas dang nor gyi phud rnams 'bul: 'di ni gces pa'i dam tshig yin: nyams na siddhi brlag par 'gyur: rjes kyang lo re ma chag par: dus tshod gza' skar bzang po la: sgrub pa zhag bdun yang yang bya: dus bzang dag la mchod pa 'bul: 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab: mdzod phugs bang ba la sogs par: mi dang gnam gyis mi mthong sba: sgrub tshe mi mngon gsang ba gces: rjes kyang gsang ba dam tshig go: de la thod pa'i 'khor yod kyang: kha ni sbub par mi bya ste: 'bru yis bkang la gzhag par bya: gus dang gces spras che bar bya: the tshom med par yid ches bya: de dag sgrub pa'i rim pa 'o: ༈ gsum pa zhal gdams zab rgya ni: thod pa'i mtshan nyid ldan gyur kyang: thod sgrub 'di nyid ma byas na: phran tshegs dngos grub 'byung srid kyang: nor bu byi dor ma byas bzhin: dgos 'dod rgya cher ster mi nus:

thod ngan bcangs na phung bar 'gyur: thod pa mtshan ldan khyad par can: skal ldan skyes bu'i lag tu 'byung: bzang po brten rung thod pa la: thod sgrub de ltar byas na ni: yid bzhin nor bu dngos su 'gyur: rjes su 'bras bu'i yon tan ni: tshe ring nad med yon tan rgyas: zas nor longs spyod bdag por 'gyur: snyan dang grags pa nor phyugs 'phel: sris sme mi zad gter la spyod: mdor na 'dod dgu ma lus 'grub: rin chen lhun grub ces bya ba'i: thod pa mchog de ma bsgrub kyang: dgos 'dod kun 'byung yod pa yin: skal ldan min pa'i lag mi 'byung: gzhan la sgrub pa 'di byas pa'i: yid bzhin nor bu mchog de yis: yid la ci bsam 'grub par 'gyur: ༈ gong gi tsakra bri ba ni: gser dngul mtshal lam dri bzang gi: snag tshas 'khor lo mu khyud gsum: rtsibs bzhi ldan pa bri bar bya: lte bar 'dod gsol mi nor zas: yid la gang 'dod stsol cig bri: de yi phyi rim rtsibs bzhi la: oṃ ratna ma hā ka pā la sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: ces bri de yi rtsibs mchan la: ratna puṇye siddhi siddhi hūm̐: dha naṃḥme dhi siddhi siddhi hūm̐: nā nā kha dhe siddhi siddhi hūm̐: dha la saṃ bho siddhi siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥdza: ces bri de yi phyi rim la: ye dharmā dang yid bzhin gyi: thod pa nor bu rin po ches: bdag la mi nor zas gsum gyi: dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: 'dod gsol dang bcas rgyas par bri: rab gnas legs byas bhandhar gzhug: gzhan yang nor lha'i snying po dang: nor rgyun ma yi gzungs la sogs: gser gyis bris te gzhug par bya: bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyal srid bdun: bris te gzhug kyang yon tan che: mdor na yid la gang bsam 'grub: nor sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di: shin tu zab phyir gter du sbas: snying gi bu mchog ma gtogs pa: mi bstan rang gi snying la bzhag: mang du spel na rang la gnod:

'di yod mi de yid bzhin gter: mi nor zas kyi bdag por 'gyur: shin tu gsang ba'i yang zab 'di: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu hya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: sa ma ya: thāthaṃ: rgya rgya rgya:1$0000250 kho bo ratna gling pa ngas// dmyal smad dge ba'i ri bo nas// dpag bsam shing rgyas brag nas bton// thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa yi// them yig med pa'i zab gces yin// shog ser ngos nas zhal bshus so/// /1$0000300 'di 'ja' tshon gter byon thod sgrub dgos 'dod re skong dang sngags kyi khyad cung zad dang tshigs bcad lhug gi khyad tsam ma gtogs shin tu gcig par snang ngo*/// /
